Janet is a descendant of Roy (Roy → Willie → Kimberly → Gloria → Natalie → Jose → Debra → Amy → Jesse → Andrea → Kelly → Victoria → George → James → Katherine → Helen → Christopher → Barbara → Linda → Jason → David → Jacqueline → Charlotte → Kayla → Jacob → Bruce → Lori → Sharon → Brian → Margaret → Janet).

Henry is also a descendant of Roy (Roy → Anthony → Douglas → Sara → Alan → Kathryn → Jean → Joyce → Amanda → Madison → Ashley → Ryan → Timothy → Zachary → Isabella → Teresa → Randy → Arthur → Julia → Shirley → Bobby → Edward → Daniel → Gregory → Rebecca → Stephen → Elizabeth → Catherine → Keith → Tyler → Dennis → Diana → Mary → Henry).

So Janet and Henry share a common ancestor.
